title: Dead or Murdered? Predicting Responsibility Perception in Femicide News Reports
reasoning: The paper investigates 'responsibility attribution' and 'blame' in the context of gender-based violence (GBV). These are central concepts in moral and ethical judgment. The study specifically evaluates how linguistic framing influences human moral perceptions of who is at fault (perpetrator vs. victim) and attempts to model these ethical judgments using NLP.
